facts.statement: Panzhousaurus fossils date to the Middle Triassic period.
The genus Panzhousaurus was described by Jiang and colleagues in 2019.
The type species of Panzhousaurus is Panzhousaurus rotundirostris.
facts.quote: The type species is P. rotundirostris.

facts.statement: The preserved holotype of Panzhousaurus is 36 cm long, with an estimated total body length of less than 50 cm.
facts.quote: The preserved portion of the holotype measures 36 cm long, and its total body length may have been less than 50 cm.

facts.statement: Panzhousaurus was a pachypleurosaur found in China during the Middle Triassic.
facts.quote: Panzhousaurus is an extinct genus of pachypleurosaur from the Middle Triassic of China.

facts.statement: Panzhousaurus is characterized by a shortened and rounded snout.
facts.quote: based on the following 4 autapomorphies (distinctive features): a shortened and rounded snout

facts.statement: The neck of Panzhousaurus consists of 24 cervical vertebrae.
facts.quote: a neck that consists of 24 cervical vertabrae

facts.statement: The upper back of Panzhousaurus consists of 20 dorsal vertebrae.
facts.quote: and an upper back that consists of 20 dorsal vertabrae

facts.statement: The ulna of Panzhousaurus was straight with a concave posterior margin.
facts.quote: an ulna which was straight with a posterior margin and concave in appearance

facts.statement: Panzhousaurus possessed four distally located carpal bones in its wrist.
facts.quote: as well as four distally located carpal (wrist) bones.

facts.statement: Panzhousaurus belongs to the parent group Pachypleurosauridae.
Panzhousaurus is classified in the family Pachypleurosauridae.
Panzhousaurus is classified as a reptile.
A new specimen of Panzhousaurus rotundirostris from the Middle Triassic Guanling Formation in China was described by Tan, Xu, and Shang in 2026.
facts.quote: Description of a new specimen of Panzhousaurus rotundirostris from the Middle Triassic (Anisian) Guanling Formation (China) and a study on the affinities of the species is published by Tan, Xu & Shang (2026).

rejected.statement: Jiang et al. described Panzhousaurus rotundirostris as a new genus and species of pachypleurosaur in 2019.
rejected.quote: In 2019, Jiang et al. described Panzhousaurus rotundirostrus as a new genus and species of pachypleurosaur
